blocks.orig: When you step into Sunshine Bay Zanzibar, you enter a tropical paradise on the beautiful white sandy beach of Matemwe, on the northeastern coast of Zanzibar. The hotel offers sixteen bungalows with fantastic ocean views and is surrounded by lush tropical gardens. Each bungalow benefits from great airflow with at least three fans in the room and wide windows to enjoy the ocean breeze. You get some refreshments next to one of the three superb swimming pools and you can take long walks on the pristine beach. Feeling hungry? Then you have nothing to worry about, as the restaurant has many options for delicious food to try. All in all, it’s the perfect place to recharge your energy as you can even spoil yourself in a spa with relaxing massages and energizing Zanzibari clove scrubs.
blocks.html: Stepping into Sunshine Bay Zanzibar means arriving in a tropical paradise on Matemwe’s beautiful white sandy beach, on the northeast coast of Zanzibar. Surrounded by lush tropical gardens, the hotel has sixteen bungalows with wonderful ocean views. Every bungalow is well ventilated, with at least three fans in the room and wide windows that let in the sea breeze. You can enjoy a cool drink beside one of the three excellent swimming pools and take long walks along the unspoilt beach. Hungry? No need to worry, because the restaurant has plenty of tasty dishes to choose from. All in all, it’s an ideal place to recharge, and you can even treat yourself at the spa to soothing massages and invigorating Zanzibari clove scrubs.
